title: Nvidia in talks to invest in Anthropic’s mega IPO
text: Nvidia in talks to invest in Anthropic’s mega IPO. The proposed listing could test investor appetite for frontier AI companies as Anthropic expands computing capacity and strengthens ties with major technology firms.
